page.overview:
What is Toxicroak?

Toxicroak is an amphibian-like Pokémon that bears a close resemblance to a Poison Dart Frog. It has sickly blue skin with a bulging red throat. Its middle toes are red as well, and on both hands, it has a poisonous red claw.

Male Toxicroak have bigger throat-sacs than the females.

It can be cruel and fearsome or it can be laid back depending on the situation or the personality of the individual.

Toxicroak is able to create a cocktail of deadly poison just by croaking; the more it croaks, the more potent the poison becomes. It attack opponents by lunging at them, ready to stab them with its poison-laced knuckle claws. Just a single scratch is enough to knock out any foe.
